name: Misfortune’s Sting (General)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Moment of chance class feature.

When a foe within 30 feet rolls a natural 1 on an attack or save, spend 1 moment of chance as an immediate action to deal 1d6 damage per two luckbringer levels to that foe.
